title: ÆTHER: Semma Paiyan v3 (Tamil dance groove, indie-pop swagger, Sufi-style chant, 1 min)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

chunks.text:
[Intro]
{female chant over a parai roll, then the full dance beat drops}
Aa-aa-aa...
(Semma!)
positive_styles: high-energy modern Tamil dance song for the dance floor, swaggering and cheeky breakup anthem: he brags he is the best guy she ever had and dances the hurt away, a big singalong
D natural minor melody (D E F G A Bb C), a Tamil folk-dance tune shape with fast gamakam slides, bends and little turns on every lead line
one steady 104 BPM Tamil dance bounce from start to end: the heavy off-beat dappankuthu swing played tight with a modern pop kick, flipping into a triplet feel at section ends
loud dry parai and thappu frame drums with tavil-style rolls underneath a punchy kick, snap and handclaps, a fat groovy bass line that moves like a second melody

modern Tamil indie-pop production meets street dance: a catchy plucky synth and mandolin riff, jazzy seventh chords on the keys, a retro brass section with stabs, layers added one by one so the groove keeps building
a laid-back, swaggering young male voice singing in Tamil with clear diction and a modern street style, half-sung half-talked verses, playful English words, cheeky ad-libs
a powerful young female voice singing a soaring wordless Sufi-style melismatic chant (aa-aa, oh-oh) that answers his hook, close and natural
a gang of friends shouting the one-word answers back like a street dance crowd
real drums and instruments close and natural, no heavy echo
loud, bright, punchy, wide modern mix with big low end
the female chant over a fast parai roll for 2 s, then the full dance beat, bass and synth riff drop together, the gang shouts 'Semma!'

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 19:06 on v1: 'doesn't have that Tamil dance mood, and doesn't have Sai Abhyankar touch'. v3 = same story and hook as v2, rebuilt on a Tamil dance bounce (off-beat dappankuthu swing, parai/thappu, fat melodic bass) with the composer's traits from music.md s13 (club-ready hooks, layered groove building, jazzy sevenths, retro brass, laid-back swaggering street vocal), gang answers, wordless female chant. No names in prompts; original melody and words. Raga: Natabhairavi (natural minor), Sa D.

story: A Chennai guy gets dumped by text on a Monday and brags he is the best guy she will ever find, dancing the hurt away with his friends while a soaring female chant answers him. Twist: he accidentally likes her new photo.
